errors.text_span: Скалата е разделена на равномерни интервали от 5000 лева
errors.evidence: The y-axis has labeled tick marks and major grid lines at intervals of 10,000, not 5,000.
The value for 2018 is approximately 49,000 thousand levs, not 5,000. The reported value is incorrect by a factor of almost 10.
The value for 2017 is approximately 72,000 thousand levs, not 7,000. The reported value is incorrect by a factor of 10.
The description only provides values for the highest (2017) and lowest (2018) years, omitting the data for 2019, 2020, and 2021, which show a trend of recovery.
